When a raging storm slams into Snuggford's Festival of Dreams, the celebration turns into a high-pressure race to keep people safe, warm, and alive as priorities shift from speed to survival.

Jump into 60 fast-paced Time Management levels where six festival locations bring unique, high-stakes challenges. Cook and serve under pressure in festival kitchens with Chef Emily, while also stepping into unique gameplay roles across the grounds.

Help Dr. Heart treat patients and provide urgent medical care, work alongside fashion designer Angela to mend outfits and provide dry clothes to soaked festivalgoers, and support interior designer Francois as he creates warmth, light, and shelter using repurposed items.
